mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in federal funds rate and decline in unemployment rate signals tightening policy during labor market strength, increasing recession risk and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime with rising housing starts and retail sales, the S&P 500 tends to underperform as economic peak approaches, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in non-farm payroll employment over the prior 3 months indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market overheating that may trigger inflation and monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and rise in housing starts signals supply-demand mismatch with supply constraints outpacing demand, leading to inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls and HOUST rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime characterized by declining industrial production and rising consumer prices, the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns as inflation erodes margins and prompts monetary tightening over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods classified as supply shock regime, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
